evals.name: skill-review-planted-faults
evals.prompt: Run a skill review on the skill at <WORK>/planted-skill. Do not file anything.
evals.expected_output: A dossier whose must-fix and should-fix sections find at least 4 of the 5 faults in evals/answer-key.json (a contradiction, a broken command, a missing rule a field expert knows, a body over the length limit, an owner-specific path), with no invented must-fix. Score it with: python3 evals/score.py <dossier> .
assertions: python3 evals/score.py exits 0 on the dossier
verified.md exists, so every must-fix was marked held or dropped with a command
nothing was filed and the fixture was not edited
